title: CSS3D Periodic Table with 3D Layouts
difficulty_analysis: L4 challenges: (1) embedding data for all 118 elements and applying category-based colors; (2) creating CSS3DRenderer and CSS3DObject cards; (3) precisely calculating coordinates for four layouts, including standard periodic-table row/column mapping, helix parameterization, uniform sphere distribution, and grid centering; (4) implementing smooth 1-second animated transitions between layouts with synchronized position and rotation tweening; (5) click selection and a details panel; (6) real-time search/filtering linked to opacity; (7) ensuring category counts are correct.
